description: Retrieves streaming traction and commercial metrics for an artist (Spotify monthly listeners, followers, popularity score) for A&R qualification.

artist_name.description: Stage name of the artist to look up.

social_links.description: Optional social media profile links for future enrichment.

spotify_id.description: Optional Spotify artist ID or open.spotify.com artist URL to target an exact artist when the name is ambiguous.

name: lookup_artist_stats
